exposure: Antenatal identification of early-onset Fetal Growth Restriction (FGR)
outcome: Severe adverse outcome (composite of stillbirth, severe newborn distress, severe neonatal outcome, severe childhood outcome)
cohort: The study included 5499 newborns born small for gestational age (SGA) in Stockholm in 2014 and 2017.
finding: Antenatal identification of early-onset FGR was associated with a decreased risk of stillbirth but an increased risk of severe newborn distress and severe childhood outcomes, while identification of late-onset FGR was only linked to an increased risk of severe childhood outcome.
